Chow Tai Fook - Blessings For Every Generation

Sometimes, the most meaningful conversations are the ones you have with yourself. In celebration of the Year of the Horse, Yang Yang meets his past self in a dialogue on growth, love, and memory – sharing blessings from his past to his present, and now, to you. Join us as we welcome the Chinese New Year in harmony, passing our legacy from our hands to yours. 一場跨越時光的自我對話，將祝福從過去延續至現在。 隨著馬年將至，楊洋與過去的自己悄然相遇，展開一段關於成長、愛與回憶的對話，讓幸福在人與人之間流轉，以福相連，世代相傳。 讓我們攜手迎接新春，將綿綿的福氣，傳遞到每個人的心中。周大福，每一代福的傳承。 #HUAcollection #FromOurHandsToYours #福的傳承
Chow Tai Fook Jewellery 周大福珠寶

如果是我的話 我想把它帶回家
讓每一代都感受到福的溫度
I was asked to tell a story about 'blessings'.
What do you think they will do with these blessings?
If it were up to me, I would want to bring it back home.
To give it to our mum and dad.
Blessings are all around us every day, given by people around you.
May the warmth of these blessings be felt through every generation.
